Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">On January 16, 2026, the Board of Directors of Mettler-Toledo International Inc. (the "Company") appointed Michael J. Tokich as a director of the Company, effective February 5, 2026, and determined Mr. Tokich qualifies as an "independent director" for purposes of the New York Stock Exchange listing standards. The Board of Directors has not yet determined on which Board committees, if any, Mr. Tokich will serve. In connection with the appointment, the Board of Directors resolved to increase its size from nine directors to ten directors, effective February 5, 2026.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">Mr. Tokich&#8217;s compensation for his services as a director will be consistent with that of the Company's other independent directors, as described in the Company's definitive proxy statement filed with the Securities Exchange Commission on March 17, 2025. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Tokich and any other persons pursuant to which Mr. Tokich was selected as a director, and there are no transactions in which Mr. Tokich has an interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div id="i0c2a0cae729c444e878858be37971b22_10"></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">On January 20, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing Mr. Tokich&#8217;s appointment. A copy of the press release is furnished hereto as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K and incorporated herein by reference.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%">The information furnished pursuant to Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K, including
